name: What is the difference between a market report and a comparative market analysis (CMA)?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a market report and a comparative market analysis (CMA)?

acceptedAnswer.text: A market report provides a broad overview of general trends across a wider geographic area or property type, offering a macro-level perspective. In contrast, a Comparative Market Analysis (CMA) is a more detailed, specific report prepared by a real estate agent for a particular property, comparing it to recently sold homes, active listings, and expired listings in its immediate vicinity. A CMA aims to determine a precise market value for a single property. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution uses both: market reports for general insight and CMAs for granular property valuation.
acceptedAnswer.description: A market report offers broad trends, while a Comparative Market Analysis (CMA) provides a precise valuation for a specific property using local comparable sales.
